text: GitHub failing a request for a moment is counted in runs of failures, each with its own record, and a success ends the current run, so the factory's half-hour bound counts from the first failure since the request last succeeded (#760). The first run keeps the record name the factory used before, failing-<post>-<request>-<pr>-<head>, so records made earlier still count, and later runs add -2, -3 and so on. Only reading a watched draft's events repeats after succeeding at the same post and head, so it alone ends its run; merging and marking ready change the pull request when they succeed. Found by a search of Invariant's implicit state machines; built by hand at @gitdek's request.
